## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (52%)** · Ambiguous: InSitu vs Benign · Careful review
The 90% conformal set includes both InSitu (52%) and Benign (42%), with 0% invasive risk [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 52%, Benign 42%, Normal 6%, Invasive 0% | Split between InSitu and Benign |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90% target coverage) | Cannot separate Benign from InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 88th OOD percentile, 12/12 tiles [F6] | Passes QC; moderately high OOD |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Yes (same top class) | Independent models agree with each other |
| Similar cases | 0/5 InSitu (4 Normal, 1 Benign; 86%–88% similarity) [F5] | Nearest neighbors contradict InSitu call |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (contribution -0.44); 19/20 AI spot-check [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (contribution -0.40), but 0/20 AI spot-check [F3] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 2, 3, 6) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (contribution -0.35); 12/20 AI spot-check [F4] · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 4) · context · Elevated score (value 0.95); 8/20 AI spot-check · Weak
- **Tumor cell fraction & nuclear shape** (regions 0, 6, 9) · context · 75% neoplastic nuclei (97th percentile) [F7]; shape variation 90th percentile [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful in dataset testing; removing top-risk regions drops invasive probability above random (95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); leans on Unreliable normal lobules (0/20 spot-check).

## Could be wrong if
- Ductal changes represent benign hyperplasia rather than DCIS, given 0/5 similar reference cases are InSitu.
- HoVer-Net misclassified benign epithelium as neoplastic, or subtle invasion exists in regions 0, 8, or 11.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 3, 6**: Evaluate intraductal atypia for DCIS versus hyperplasia; consider drafted ER, CK5/6, and deeper levels.
2. **Regions 6, 9**: Verify whether dense neoplastic-flagged nuclei (135 and 88 cells) represent true neoplastic proliferation.
3. **Regions 0, 8, 11**: Inspect highest-risk tiles (risk 0.001–0.005) and region 0 stroma to exclude microinvasion.

found: The CONCH–MUSK row names InSitu, but agreement.conch_musk_same_top only says the two models agree with each other; the JSON does not say which class they chose.
